title: The tail plays
idea: Shelf's bookmark with one straight cut that carries the notch's right edge on through the apex to the left side; the paper under the cut, the bookmark's own left tail, is a play triangle. The notch is cut at the same angle as the app's play button (32.9 degrees against Lucide's 32.7), so the play was already inside the bookmark and the outline stays whole.
built: Today's bookmark at 42 dp wide, scale 42/34: notch 13.59, shoulders r 4.94, tips r 1.85, no proportion changed; drawn box centred like the reference, reach 32.06 of 33. The line through the right tip and the apex, carried on, meets the left edge two notches above the tips (y 53.5) and is the body's whole lower edge. The play's top edge is that line moved 3.2 dp down, square to it; its bottom edge is the notch's own left flank, so the two are mirror images and the play is isosceles, 23.4 tall and 18.1 deep (0.77; the app's play is 0.78), its tip about 3 dp short of the apex. Its corners take the tail tips' radius, r 1.85, since one of them is a tail tip. The cut opens to the left edge at one end and into the notch at the other, so there is no hole and the outline is exactly the reference bookmark's.
small: 48 px: everything, bookmark 28 x 34 px, notch 9 (slope 9/14); the cut drops 4 px (3.4 square to the line) so its ends land on whole pixels; play 14 x 10.9 px. 32 px: everything, 18 x 22, notch 6, cut 3 px (2.5 square), play 9 x 6.75. 16 px: redrawn in whole pixels, 10 x 12; the line and the notch become 45 degree stairs, as the brand's own 16 px cut does with its notch, the cut a 2 px step and the play 6, 4 and 2 px tall in three columns (2.2% soft pixels against the reference's 14.7). Glyph: 16 x 20 inside the padding, cut 3 px (2.5 square), play 7 x 5.6.
risks: A diagonal through a bookmark can read as a slash, the convention for 'bookmark off'; here it runs only through the tail and the play under it gives it a reason, but it is the main risk. It can also read as a page with a folded corner and a play, a media-file icon. Google Play Books also pairs a bookmark with a play (a rounded play triangle with a bookmark inside); here the bookmark is the outline and the play a quarter of it. The play is paper, where Richard described a dark play: the dark here is the cut and the notch. At 16 px the play is a six-pixel hint.
